GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th Inside 3 Lengths 3rd @ 600m 2 Lengths Hooked Out Straightening Up ran Leader down x 100m, kept on to the line - # Sound eff. 53.5

Bit Slow Out Quickly Recovered Went Forward Settled Down 4th Inside 4 Lengths with 1st following 2 Lengths behind, enjoyed good trail to Turn 3 Lengths , Straightening Up 4th and Ridden Along then couldn't quicken - had its chance - # run ended 100m
Jumped Ok sat 3l off 3 Wide trail, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, running on joined in 100m, took over 50m drew clear late # All honours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Pushed fwd & raced 4th Two Wide (2.5L from lead) early . Tracked leaders on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid out Five Wide @ 300m & worked to lead @ 200m. Drew clear in last 150m. # Had perfect run
Bit Slow Out .5l Settled Down Mid Field 6th 5l 800m 5th 4l home turn held up 5th took split Straight Middle Of Track to win with authority # good ride/win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped with another rnr. Approaching the 100m shifted out under pressure before being corrected by its rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 6th 4 Lengths off leader/winner 8th x 600m 6 Lengths asked to go at the 400m, couldn't quicken - # couldn't finish off
Jumped Ok sat handy 2-3l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 3l off , hit line well just no match leader/winner # had run/good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 600m was inconvenienced. Briefly held up for clear running in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on sat 3l off, held together turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, battled on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 1-2 Lengths off all clear, joined in passing 200m, took over 100m and drew clear late # had run/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out and bumped on jumping. Shifted out abruptly over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Settled Down 7th Inside 5 Lengths off leader/winner held together same to straightening up held-up Inside Nowhere To Go Until line, Inconclusive (xovnb1st) # badly held-up
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; settled midfield. Began awkwardly and bumped heavily at the start. Held up for clear running from the 400m until near the 250m where it was disappointed for a run, then remained held up for the remainder of the event and, as a consequence, was not able to be tested.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Four Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Stayed same until improving slowly Five Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Six Wide @ 400m & 8W (4L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground in straight. Vetted - slow recovery. # Always back & wide.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re performance, rdr std specifically instructed not to lead & to obtain a position immediately behind leaders. Std after beginning well & when inside rnrs showed intent to go forward he elected to restrain mnt to rear of field to avoid being caught wide. Added mnt did not travel at any stage & was disappointing in manner it finished race off. A post-race vet exam revealed mare to be slow to recover. Tnr reported mare pulled up well & whilst it had previously performed on Heavy (8) going, it may not have relished the testing Heavy (10) going first-up.
